OverlayVisualization.Name: Elevation Overlay Enabled
OverlayVisualization.Hint: Enable the visual overlay on scene canvas to indicate square elevation set by this module.

ElevationScaling.Name: Token Elevation Scaling
ElevationScaling.Hint: when enabled, tokens will scale up/down slightly when moving onto elevated tiles to appear closer or further from the camera.

OverlayStyle.Name: Overlay Mode
OverlayStyle.Hint: Choose which style of visualization to use. Gradient creates a drop shadow on lower squares, Colored Tile highlights all elevated squares with their designated color.

ColorOpacity.Name: Colored Tile Opacity
ColorOpacity.Hint: Choose the opacity of the Colored Tile overlay if enabled.

NumberOverlay.Name: Number Overlay Enabled
NumberOverlay.Hint: Enable a numerical overlay on the canvas to label the elevation of squares.

NumberOverlayColor.Name: Add Color to Number Overlay
NumberOverlayColor.Hint: Enable colorful numbers when the number overlay is enabled.

TerrainStyle.Name: Terrain Overlay Style
TerrainStyle.Hint: Choose how intense the shading is for the difficult terrain overlay

ElevationColorMenu.Name: Set Elevation Colors
ElevationColorMenu.Hint: Choose the color used to represent each elevation. (used in Colored Tile overlay, colored number overlay, and Elevation Painter)
ElevationColorMenu.Label: Configure Colors
